content:
Alex Chen: Heads up — prod-hosted-4 reported 3 OOMs around 08:12 PDT during several 15k-22k token chats. Observed a sharp KV heap jump right after the runtime switched kernels (auto select).

infra-bot: [alert] instance=prod-hosted-4 metric=kv_heap usage=94% -> OOM at 08:12:17

Priya Nair: Ugh. Any quick repro or trace? Is this the same spike we saw last month? :thinking_face:

Alex Chen: Not identical. This one correlates with kernel switch to `fp16-int8-eager` (heuristic picked due to throughput pattern). I pasted the short profiler dump: 

```
kv_pool.total_bytes=12.3GB
kv_pool.allocated=11.6GB
kv_fragments=432
last_kernel=fp16-int8-eager
allocs: spike at step ~7431 (20k ctx)
prefix_cache_hits ~0.02
```

Ravi Patel: That fragment count looks high vs capacity. Could be fragmentation + allocator internal slack after kernel change. Was compaction triggered?

Alex Chen: Compaction tried but returned low reclaim (~120MB). Paging kicked in, then a few retries, then final OOM.

Maya Li: Quick mitigation suggestions: 1) force a conservative kernel pin for that host (no auto-switch) 2) bump eviction aggressiveness 3) enable temporary KV-prefetch throttle. Which is least risky?

Priya Nair: Pin kernel as emergency rollback. Low blast radius. Eviction/aggressiveness changes risk higher perf regressions but avoid OOMs long-term. Prefetch throttle seems safe immediate.

Ravi Patel: Agree. Also propose a graceful degrade: if KV alloc > 85% for > 30s, switch to "recompute-on-demand" fallback for large prefixes (we already have the shim). That would avoid hard OOMs at cost of extra compute.

Alex Chen: Plan I ran locally (small rollout):

1) pin kernel to `fp16-stable` on prod-hosted-4
2) set `kv.eviction.window=30s` and `kv.eviction.aggressiveness=0.8`
3) enable `kv.prefetch.throttle=0.6` for long-context jobs
4) add autotriggers: if kv_used>85% for 30s -> enable recompute-shim

Rolling this to canary now.

Priya Nair: Can you paste the deploy command so I can watch? Also open a short incident doc (link) with logs & config diff.

Alex Chen: Deploy command: `./infra/deploy-host --host prod-hosted-4 --set kernel=fp16-stable --set kv.eviction.aggressiveness=0.8 --set kv.prefetch.throttle=0.6`

Incident doc: https://docs.internal/runs/kv-heap-surge-2740012345 (created)

infra-bot: Deploy started by Alex Chen -> job=deploy-8723 status=running

Maya Li: I'll follow up with a micro-benchmark to see how much latency/p50 jumps with recompute-shim. If it's <8% we're fine.

Ravi Patel: Post-rollout next steps: (a) collect fragmentation histograms over 24h (b) test background compaction tuning (c) evaluate allocator patch that reduces per-fragment slack. I'll own (a) and (b). Alex take (c)?

Alex Chen: Yep I'll take the allocator slack patch prototype. Will ping when I have a PR.

Priya Nair: Thanks. Will keep this thread updated with rollout status. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Deploy job=deploy-8723 status=success duration=45s

Alex Chen: Rollout done, immediate OOMs stopped. We'll monitor for 6h and then decide on global knob or targeted fixes.

Priya Nair: Marking as follow-up for next eng-runtime sync.
